# Keenan Jusak

> Damianus Keenan Jusak ("Keenan Jusak") is a Mathematics and Statistics BSc student at the
> University of Warwick and a Global Excellence Scholar, with a deep interest in finance,
> especially quantitative finance, markets, and risk. He works on stochastic modelling,
> actuarial mathematics, and machine learning, and builds them into tools people actually use.

- Website: https://keenanjusak.com
- Based in: Coventry, United Kingdom, and Jakarta, Indonesia
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/damianus-keenan-jusak-74552623b/
- Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/keenanjusak

## Education

- **University of Warwick — BSc Mathematics and Statistics** (2026–2029, current).
  Awarded the Global Excellence Scholarship.
- **University of Warwick — Foundation in Mathematics & Statistics** (September 2025 – June 2026).
  Overall grade 93. Global Excellence Scholarship.
- **Canisius College, Jakarta — High School Diploma, Natural Sciences** (July 2022 – May 2025).
  Grade 92.3, Magna Cum Laude.

## Projects

- **Infinitics 8 Competition — Cyber Insurance Pricing (1st place).** Modelled computer state
  transitions (Susceptible, Infected, Quarantined, Damaged) as a continuous-time Markov chain,
  adapting the epidemiological SIR framework to computer networks. Used Monte Carlo simulation to
  generate loss distributions and linked the CTMC output to actuarial pricing formulas. Resulted in
  a scholarship offer to study actuarial mathematics at Universitas Pelita Harapan, Indonesia.
- **BayesQuiz (by TigaData).** Educational quiz platform that uses Bayesian inference to update
  question-difficulty estimates as students answer. Built with React and Firebase. 70+ quizzes and
  400+ student accounts.
- **IMC Prosperity 4 — algorithmic trading (top 10% of 18,800 teams, solo entry).** Built trading
  models across a 50-product simulated market, combining linear regression and EMA-based fair value
  forecasting with mean-reversion and market-making logic, and pricing options positions with
  Black-Scholes. Applied game-theoretic bid optimisation in the manual auction rounds.
- **Proofly (by TigaData).** Full-stack exam-preparation platform for the TMUA (Test of Mathematics
  for University Admission), built solo end to end: React and Vite frontend, Supabase for the
  database, row-level security and authentication, and Stripe for subscription billing. Owned
  authentication, subscriptions, and deployment.
- **Diabetes Prediction.** Benchmarking study of supervised learning algorithms for predicting
  diabetes onset from clinical measurements, comparing logistic regression, decision trees, random
  forests, SVMs, and gradient boosting under cross-validation, with feature-importance analysis.
- **DRW Crypto Forecasting Competition.** Short-horizon crypto price forecasting on a noisy,
  high-dimensional feature set using PCA, feature selection, engineered momentum and mean-reversion
  signals, and tuned LightGBM and XGBoost models.

- **Tools:** SQL, OpenAI API, Supabase, Firebase, cPanel, LaTeX, PowerPoint.
- **Languages:** Indonesian (native), English (fluent, IELTS 8.0).
